summary: Amendment to temporary danger area EGD170 at Guildford, stating drone flights may take place, up to 990 feet.
text:
AIP SUPPLEMENT 132/2026 - TEMPORARY DANGER AREA EGD170 
(GUILDFORD),
BVLOS RPAS OPERATIONS, 12 NOVEMBER - 09 DECEMBER 2026
PARA 1 
DELETE: WILL TAKE PLACE BETWEEN 12 NOVEMBER AND 09 DECEMBER 2026 
INSERT: MAY TAKE PLACE BETWEEN 12 NOVEMBER AND 09 DECEMBER 2026
PARA 4
DELETE: FLIGHTS WILL TAKE PLACE DURING THE FOLLOWING PERIODS
INSERT: FLIGHTS MAY TAKE PLACE DURING THE FOLLOWING PERIODS
